newsitem.title: USA: LIN Television sees lower 1997 growth.
newsitem.headline: LIN Television sees lower 1997 growth.

text.p: LIN Television Corp on Tuesday said it expected single-digit growth in advertising revenues in 1997, including a flat first quarter, after piling up record earnings in 1996.
The company said 1996 revenues were boosted by non-recurring factors, such as the televised Summer Olympics and political advertising.

But the company said 1997 still would be a strong year, discounting comparisons with the unusual year of 1996. Increased revenues, market share and broadcast cash flow are expected particularly from its stations in Dallas and Austin, Texas; Hartford, Conn.; and Norfolk, Va.
